$comment: The gaps hirobius/hds#628 predicts, as ids a gaps.json may reuse so the index can count one gap across screens. A prediction is not a finding: confirm a gap with evidence or leave it out. A gap that is not here gets its own kebab-case id, or none.

ids.summary: A file drop or upload control with per-file progress and retry.
An activity timeline: who did what, when, newest first (lead history, drop status history).
A stage chain or stepper that reads as a funnel, with a count per stage.
A band section: a header with a name and a count, rows, and "show all".
A phone action bar or bottom sheet for thumb-reachable actions.
A supporting accent token, the second half of the planned accent pair (North Star).
